image_description:
Originally intended to serve as a multi-purpose Omani general service medal (along British lines), for service of at least six weeks with a unit of at least company size, the medal has to date only been awarded with one clasp, for the Dhofar Rebellion.
Ribbon: Equal of red, off-white, and green. The original ribbon design was intended to represent the three regiments of the Omani army: the Muscat Regiment (red), the Northern Frontier Regiment (green), and the Desert Regiment (sand), but there is also the interpretation that the colors represented blood, sand, and the green of the Jebel Akhdar region.

image_description: A portrait of Atatürk from the 1930s. Kemal Atatürk (Mustafa Kemal Pasha until 1934, Kamâl Atatürk from 1935 to 1937, commonly referred to as Mustafa Kemal Atatürk; 1881 – 10 November 1938) was a Turkish field marshal, revolutionary statesman, author, and the founding father of the Republic of Turkey, serving as its first President from 1923 until his death in 1938. (He was elected president four times.) He undertook sweeping progressive reforms, which modernized Turkey into a secular, industrializing nation. Ideologically a secularist and nationalist, his policies and theories became known as Kemalism. Due to his military and political accomplishments, Atatürk is regarded as one of the most important political leaders of the 20th century.

image_description:
Atik Girit Madalyası: 36 mm. 24 gr. (gümüş). İhtas Tarihi: H.1285, M.1868. Madalyanın Tuğrasını Hüsrev Efendi, Yazılarını Naif Efendi, Resim ve nakışlarını Mr.Robertson yapmıştır.Kyrdelasi kırmızıdır.

Bu madalya Girit Adasının hizmetinde bulunmuş olan kara ve deniz asker ve subaylarıyla, askeri komutanlara ve diğer memurlara, nışanı iftiharı olamak üzere imal edilmiştir. Giritli Rum isyancılar, 1866 tarihinde Hacı Mihail önderliğinde ayaklanarak adayı Yunanistan'a iltihak ettiklerini açıklamışlardır. Bunun üzerine Osmanlı Devleti, hem isyanı bastırarak adaya hakim olmak ve hem de Girit'e büyük devletlerin müdahelesine imkan bırakmamak için yönetsel düzenlemelere gitmiş, bu iş için Ali Paşa'yı görevlendirmiştir.

15 Şubat 1968 de yayımlanan Girit nizamnamesinde Türk'lerin ve Rum'ların yerel çoğunluğuna dayalı yönetimmeclisleri ile bu meclislerin çalışmalarıyla ilgili kanun ve yönetmelikler hazırlanmıştır. İşte bu madalya Girit isyanında görev yapan askerler ve yukarıda belirtilenlere verilmiştir.

Kemal Atatürk (or alternatively written as Kamâl Atatürk, Mustafa Kemal Pasha until 1934, commonly referred to as Mustafa Kemal Atatürk; 1881 – 10 November 1938) was a Turkish field marshal, revolutionary statesman, author, and the founding father of the Republic of Turkey, serving as its first President from 1923 until his death in 1938. He undertook sweeping progressive reforms, which modernized Turkey into a secular, industrializing nation. Ideologically a secularist and nationalist, his policies and theories became known as Kemalism. Due to his military and political accomplishments, Atatürk is regarded as one of the most important political leaders of the 20th century.

file_title: File:Médaille en bronze doré du concours international du commerce de Suez.jpg
object_name: Médaille en bronze doré du concours international du commerce de Suez
image_description: Médaille en bronze doré du concours international du commerce de Suez. Le premier canal fut commencé par le pharaon Senousret III (1887-1849 BC) et achevé par Séthi Ier et Ramsès II. Ferdinand de Lesseps (1805-1894), vice-consul de France à Alexandrie, avait convaincu le khédive Mohammed Saïd, dont il était l'ami, de construire un canal reliant la Méditerranée et la mer Rouge. Les firmans de 1854 et de 1856 préparèrent et précisèrent l'acte de concession du 25 novembre 1854 qui permettait à Ferdinand de Lesseps d'entreprendre la construction du canal. Le firman de 1856 prévoyait la libre circulation. Le capital fut souscrit par la France pour plus de la moitié et le vice-roi d'Égypte pour un quart. Les travaux commencèrent en 1859 et durèrent dix ans. Le canal fut inauguré le 17 novembre 1869. Sa longueur était en 1869 de 52 kms et sa largeur de 44 mètres.

seed_category: Orders, decorations and medals of the Ottoman Empire
image_description:
Åttauddig strålstjärna av guld med välvda bladknippen om fem blad med graverad dekor, över fyra av knippena fäst ett grönemaljerat skriftband med turkisk text i guld (fosterlandskärlek, idoghet, tapperhet, trohet).

Svagt välvd, grönemaljerad medaljong med sultanens toughra i guld. Däromkring ring av 18 briljantslipade glasbitar, guldfattning à jour. På det översta bladet en fast ring, däri fäst på framsidan grönemaljerad, fasetterad halvmåne och femuddig stjärna.

På månens baksida en rörformig bygel, däri fäst ett spetsovalt blad av guld med graverad dekor, på baksidan en bygel, i vilken bandet (nr 1409) är fastbundet.

seed_category: Orders, decorations and medals of the Ottoman Empire
file_title: File:Silver Turkish Crimea medal (Sardinian version) issued to Private William Greenwood of Britain.JPG
object_name: Silver Turkish Crimea medal (Sardinian version) issued to Private William Greenwood of Britain
image_description:
This Silver Turkish Crimea medal was made circa 1855 and is of the pattern originally itended for issue by Turkey's Sardinian allies for their services against Imperial Russia in the Crimean War. This side (the reverse side) features a cannon, mortar and anchor standing on the Russian flag, a map of the Crimea is spread over the cannon, with the four flags of Turkey and her allies in the background.The medal is in a swivel setting within rope twist border.It has been mounted as a brooch at some point.Along the edge of the medal there is the inscription, 'NO. 1878. CR. SERJT. W. GREENWOOD. 33RD. D. R. REGT.' 1855

This is the Sardinian version of the medal, but many were given to British troops, due to the fact a ship bringing part of the consignment of medals to Britain sank.In order to rectify the problem the Turks later gave Sardinian and French strikings to British troops.

The 33rd Regiment of Foot was part of The Duke of Wellington's Regiment

41mm diameter.

Inventory number: HARGM 5140
artist: Staff or representatives of Harrogate Museums and Arts service
commons_categories: Turkish Crimea Medal|Images from Harrogate Museums and Arts
